endorsements.quote: Beyond acquiring a technical understanding of the topic, research on LLMs requires thorough documentation of model configuration and prompt design, consistent version control, management of output variability, and clear definitions for the role of human oversight.

unlisted_practices: Balance the rapid implementation of e-health solutions with rigorous validation to ensure patient safety and optimal outcomes.
Policymakers and healthcare organisations should prioritise funding and resources for high-quality research to close the evidence gap.
Foster collaboration among academia, industry, and clinical practice to generate relevant evidence and support sustainable integration of digital tools.
Develop standardised protocols and ensure interoperability among digital health systems to enable data sharing and more comprehensive evaluation of digital tools.
Involve healthcare professionals, patients, and policymakers in the research process on digital health solutions.
Adopt a strategic approach to AI implementation that mitigates cyber-security risks such as data leakage and data poisoning.
Foster research collaboration between experts in computer science, AI, and primary care research.
Establish dedicated guidelines, protocols, and coordinated infrastructure for study design and reporting of LLM research in real-world clinical settings.

screen.reason: This is a commentary discussing the challenges, benefits, drawbacks, and priorities for AI implementation in primary care practice.
